tickerText: [TENNIS] Alex de Minaur beat Stefanos Tsitsipas 6-4, 3-6, 6-3 to launch his DC Open title defense and will face 17-year-old Cruz Hewitt, while Alex Eala ousted defending champion Leylah Fernandez • [SQUASH] The Dallas Squash Challenger opens today in Plano, Texas, with top seed Leonel Cardenas leading a 32-player main draw through August 2 • [BADMINTON] Defending mixed doubles champions Chen Tang Jie and Toh Ee Wei withdrew from the BWF World Championships as Toh continues ACL rehab; Wong Tien Ci and Lim Chiew Sien were promoted • [PICKLEBALL] The Wisconsin PPA Challenger begins July 31 in Lake Hallie, while Pickleball Inc. and the Pickleball World Cup opened the door for PPA pros to represent their countries from 2027 • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT Champions Yokohama starts August 4 after Hugo Calderano edged Alexis Lebrun 4-3 to win the Star Contender in São José dos Campos

newsItems.title: De Minaur Beats Tsitsipas at DC Open
newsItems.excerpt: Top seed Alex de Minaur overcame Stefanos Tsitsipas in three sets to begin his Washington title defense and will next face 17-year-old qualifier Cruz Hewitt.

newsItems.title: Chen/Toh Withdraw From Worlds
newsItems.excerpt: Defending mixed doubles champions Chen Tang Jie and Toh Ee Wei pulled out of the BWF World Championships in New Delhi as Toh continues rehab from ACL surgery.

newsItems.title: Wisconsin Challenger Up Next
newsItems.excerpt: The PPA Challenger Series heads to Lake Hallie, Wisconsin, from July 31 to August 2, bringing amateur and aspiring pros to Gower Park for the Midwest stop.

newsItems.title: Yokohama Champions Await
newsItems.excerpt: The WTT circuit shifts to Champions Yokohama on August 4 after Hugo Calderano outlasted Alexis Lebrun 4-3 to win the Star Contender in São José dos Campos.
